Overview

Humenné is a city in Prešov Region with a population of 32,000. A town in eastern Slovakia near the Ukrainian border, known for its Renaissance castle, the Vihorlat Mountains, and a growing industrial sector. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
